title: Wet-dry-wet drug screen leads to the synthesis of TS1, a novel compound reversing lung fibrosis through inhibition of myofibroblast differentiation
summary: ML analysis of an earlier fibroblast screen virtually screened millions of compounds; synthesised dopamine-related hits including TS1 inhibited myofibroblast activation ex vivo and reversed fibrosis in the reported models.
ai_technology: Machine-learning virtual screen trained on HTS data

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.
